title: Existence and uniqueness of local scalar action sections
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], B and C sheaves of commutative O_X-algebras [def-weil-pbc-ringed-space-algebra-module], p:B → C an algebra morphism, and I a sheaf of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with an inclusion i:I → B in a short exact sequence 0 → I → B → C → 0 [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Suppose the product of any two sections killed by p is zero on every open. For every open U, f in C(U) and x in I(U), there exists a unique y in I(U) such that for every inclusion j:V → U and every b in B(V) with p(b)=f|V, one has i(y|V)=b*i(x|V).

proof.text: Apply the epimorphism clause of module_exactness_local_lifting to the underlying module map p, which is epi by short exactness, to obtain a cover of U with lifts b_a of f.

Naturality and i followed by p equal to zero show all restrictions of i(x) are killed by p. If p(b)=p(c) and p(t)=0, square-zero gives (b-c)*t=0 and hence b*t=c*t. Apply this to the restricted lifts on each pairwise intersection to obtain compatible products.

Use Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' in B to glue these products to z. On the lifting cover p(z)=0 by naturality, multiplicativity and p(i(x))=0; TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' in C proves p(z)=0 globally. Evaluation preserves kernels and i is mono, so ShortComplex.Exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel and ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff yield y in I(U) with i(y)=z.

For any inclusion W into U and lift c over W, the intersections W intersect V_a cover W. Naturality, the gluing identities for z, and the same square-zero difference calculation prove the desired formula on each intersection. TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' in B gives the formula on W.

For two candidate sections, their images under i restrict to the same products on the lifting cover. Separatedness in B makes those images equal on U. Evaluation preserves the monomorphism i, and ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective gives equality of the two sections. All cover arguments include the empty open.

proof_origin.place: Cohomology, Lemma 0B8S proof; Lean assembly by R4: glue products in B and use sectionwise kernel exactness instead of gluing local preimages in I.

theorem square_zero_glued_scalar_exists_unique (X : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (p : B ⟶ C)
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (i : I ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B)
    (hw : i ≫ (commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk i ((commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p) hw).ShortExact)
    (hsq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (x y : B.right.obj.obj (op U)),
      p.right.hom.app (op U) x = 0 → p.right.hom.app (op U) y = 0 → x * y = 0) :
    ∀ (U : X.Opens) (f : C.right.obj.obj (op U)) (x : I.val.obj (op U)),
      ∃! y : I.val.obj (op U),
        ∀ (V : X.Opens) (j : V ⟶ U) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op V)),
          p.right.hom.app (op V) b = C.right.obj.map j.op f →
            @id (B.right.obj.obj (op V))
              (i.val.app (op V) (I.val.map j.op y)) =
                b * @id (B.right.obj.obj (op V))
                  (i.val.app (op V) (I.val.map j.op x))
